scope: Actual Chromium and shipped Service Worker with synthetic same-origin iframe/Worker cache bodies; compare old response metadata with isolation headers added to identical bytes. Not a full editor/model or deployment check.
limitations: Synthetic iframe and Worker bodies under owned same-origin test URLs, not full native editors or model weights.
No actual deployment header migration, browser HTTP-cache upgrade or physical device coverage.
This tests Cache API response metadata with the shipped worker; header migration was performed by the test, not implemented in the product.
diagnosticNote: Initial synthetic worker URL used stale-while-revalidate and was overwritten by a 25,505-byte server fallback; worker failed after metadata update. Offline emulation also reported navigator.onLine true after navigation. Final uses vendor cache-first Worker URL, changes only two target entries, reapplies offline emulation after navigation and verifies byte identity. Initial run is not proof of migration success.
